summary: Verified the new 'Près de moi' (nearby) feature end-to-end via Playwright with granted geolocation at Paris (48.8566, 2.3522). All 5 review-request scenarios PASS: nearby-prompt shown before geolocation, geolocate-btn auto-switches to nearby tab, exactly 7 cards (one per carrier, all distinct, all with km badges), nearby-locate-btn also triggers geolocation, and regressions on tab-all/carrier-filter/search still work.

nearby_prompt_before_geo.expected: tab-nearby shows nearby-prompt with nearby-locate-btn and no point cards
nearby_prompt_before_geo.actual: prompt visible, locate button visible, 0 point-card testids in aside

geolocate_btn_auto_switch_paris.expected: geolocate-btn auto-switches to nearby tab, results-count = 'Le plus proche par transporteur', up to 7 cards one-per-carrier with km distance
geolocate_btn_auto_switch_paris.actual: tab-nearby became active, results-count='Le plus proche par transporteur', 7 cards rendered, km badges 7/7, carriers=['Mondial Relay','Chronopost','La Poste','DPD','UPS','Relais Colis','Colis Privé'] — all 7 distinct. Map recentered to Paris (visible in screenshot). Success toast 'Position détectée' shown.

distinct_carrier_per_card.expected: each of the 7 cards is a different carrier
distinct_carrier_per_card.actual: 7 unique carrier_name text values matching the 7 supported carriers exactly

nearby_locate_btn_triggers_geolocation.expected: clicking nearby-locate-btn inside prompt also triggers geolocation and populates the nearby list
nearby_locate_btn_triggers_geolocation.actual: After reload+click tab-nearby+click nearby-locate-btn, results-count='Le plus proche par transporteur' and 7 cards rendered

regression.map_clustering_and_recenter: Leaflet cluster + Paris recenter visible in screenshot

critical_code_review_comments: nearestByCarrier logic in MapApp.js uses points.find per carrier — correct only because backend returns points sorted by ascending distance when lat/lng are passed. This is documented behavior of GET /api/points. Safe.
Backend returns all matching points (2220) — nearestByCarrier is derived client-side. For future scale, consider a dedicated /api/nearest endpoint returning just the 7 nearest server-side.

Panel is rendered twice (desktop aside + mobile sheet) causing duplicate data-testids (pre-existing; iteration_1). Tests scope selectors to 'aside' to avoid ambiguity; still recommend gating mobile Panel via responsive rendering.
geolocate() correctly triggers setTab('nearby') AND setUserLoc(loc) so /api/points re-fetches with lat/lng and PointCard shows km badges.
test_credentials: Not required for nearby feature. Admin admin@relaispoint.fr / admin123 available for favorites regression (not re-tested here — passed in iteration_1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) + context.set_geolocation({latitude, longitude}) BEFORE page.goto to simulate a browser position. Scope aside for point-card queries because the mobile Panel duplicates data-testids. Initial load takes ~5-8s to fetch 2220 points; wait for results-count to contain '2220'. The 'Ma position' button is in the panel header (geolocate-btn); nearby-locate-btn is inside nearby-prompt shown when tab==='nearby' && !userLoc.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature implemented correctly; no bugs found.
